text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Trainer, look at how excited
everyone is!
Oh, oops!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I can't get ahead of myself just yet. The
Gratitude
Festival begins tomorrow. We
have to make sure
we finish all the final
checks by today!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Yay, I did it, I did it! I won!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Welcome, you two! I'm so glad to
see you
here!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Want to try your luck? You get a free

chocolate-covered banana if you can
beat me in
a round of rock, paper,
scissors, and you get an
extra if the stick
has "WINNER!" written on it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A certain someone told me people tend
to gather
in places with fun
atmospheres, and business has
been
booming thanks to that advice!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's great! Ehehe! The hustle and
bustle drew us
over here, so it seems we
aren't immune to it
either!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to try my luck! I'm gonna
win a
bunch!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew! So many victories and "WINNER!"
sticks. I'm
absolutely stuffed! Let's get
moving so I can burn
off—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Eeeheeheehee! Welcome, welcome! I've
been
waiting for you! Prepare to be
frightened out of
your skin!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The haunted house! R-right, we need to check that too. I've already gone through it before, so it won't scare me that much!
I want... your speedy legs...
GIVE ME YOUR LEEEEGSSS!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: EEEEEK!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we gotta get out here! FAST!
NOW! GO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I turn to run, but as I do, I feel my body
lift off
the floor...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... huff... pant... W-we made it out alive!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry... I just threw you over my
shoulder
without realizing it! I didn't
think we would make
it out in time if I
just pulled you by the hand...
choice_data_list: 担がれて移動しちゃったけど……！
choice_data_list_en: Even though I ended up getting carried around...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Sorry! I can't believe I just
hauled you
around like a sack of rice...
Hehehe... Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, Kitasan Black and I check
out the rest
of the festival and the night
passes by in the blink
of an eye...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Festivals really are the best!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've had my fill of food and laughter! I
got to yell
and holler all I wanted, and
everyone was so
excited... I had a great
time.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wait! Oh nooo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, oh no, oh noooo! We got so
absorbed in
having fun that I forgot we
were supposed to be
doing final checks
around the place!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A
text_block_list.text: Nah, don't sweat it, Kita!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All right, folks. All together on three,
two, one...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Staff
text_block_list.text:
We did it!
"Operation: Make Kita Have a
Great Time!" is a
huge success!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Operation what?! Wait... Does that
mean
putting me in charge of doing final
checks was
just a ploy to make me enjoy
myself?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, we knew if we invited you two
normally, you
probably would've tried to
help out as a way to
pay us back for the
invitation.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper B
text_block_list.text:
So instead, we thought it'd be better to
just
create a temporary role for you and
trick you into
coming!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you got us. I don't know what to
say...
Ahem.
choice_data_list: 気をつかってもらったんですね
choice_data_list_en: They were being very considerate of you, weren't they?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm so, so happy!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You all put so much of yourselves into
this
festival, and it was so fun! Seriously,
I had a blast!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You all put so much of yourselves into
this
festival, and it was so fun! Seriously,
I had a blast!
choice_data_list: 全部キタサンのおかげだ
全部キタサンのおかげだよ
大変なこともあったような……？
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, that was so much fun!
Yeah, that was so much fun!
I feel like there were some rough times, too...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Goodness, you two are so in sync.
choice_data_list: 全部キタサンのおかげだ
全部キタサンのおかげだよ
大変なこともあったような……？
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, that was so much fun!
Yeah, that was so much fun!
I feel like there were some rough times, too...?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I don't think anyone can compete
with how
close you two are.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hmm... I guess you're right! You
won't find
two better friends on more
equal wavelengths!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: My, now you're just showing off!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Well, it's the truth! Trainer, you're
always
by my side because you feel the
same, right?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper B
text_block_list.text:
All right, keep showing us that awesome

teamwork!
choice_data_list: もちろん、同じ気持ちだ！
もちろん、同じ気持ちだよ！
choice_data_list_en: Of course, I feel the same way!
Of course, I feel the same way!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Will do! We'll do our very best together,
so I
hope you'll keep cheering us on!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thank you! I appreciate the
praise, but you
know what?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You can't pull off a festival all on your
own.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A festival is a group effort, built when
you answer
the festival's cheers with
your own. I learned that
from watching
my dad in action...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the joy we're feeling now
is thanks
to everyone combining their
energy and working
toward a common
goal!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper B
text_block_list.text: Sniffle! Hehe, that's our Kita! Your words really hit me deep!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you can cry after our
resounding
success tomorrow! Let's make
it a day to
remember!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Staff
text_block_list.text: YEAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone pumps their fists in the air. The
passion
and unity they display on the
night before the
festival is quite a
moving sight to behold.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: W-well, you know! It wasn't... that bad...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Are you talking about the
haunted house?
The way you reacted
while going through it was
really
something!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No kidding. You set a record for time
taken to
get through the haunted house.
choice_data_list: 入り口から出口まで一瞬だった
choice_data_list_en: It was over in an instant from entrance to exit.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Umm... Er...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm going to redeem myself by going
through a
different haunted house!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So, uh, I'd really appreciate it if you
could stick
with me until I manage to
conquer my fear!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her honest personality draws warm
laughter from
those around her. And I
feel like I’ve just
discovered yet another
reason why everyone’s so
fond of her.
